entries.title: Numbers 21:1
segments: ¶The king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South, heard that Israel was coming on the road to Atharim, then he fought against Israel and took [some] of them prisoners.

entries.title: Numbers 21:2
segments: So Israel made a vow to the LORD, and said, "If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities."

entries.title: Numbers 21:3
segments: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites, and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. So the name of that place was called Hormah.

entries.title: Numbers 21:4
segments: ¶Then they journeyed from Mount Hor by the Way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the soul of the people became very discouraged on the way.

entries.title: Numbers 21:5
segments: And the people spoke against God and against Moses: "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For [there is] no food and no water, and our soul loathes this worthless bread."

entries.title: Numbers 21:6
segments: So the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many of the people of Israel died.

entries.title: Numbers 21:7
segments: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against you; pray to the LORD that He take away the serpents from us." So Moses prayed for the people.

entries.title: Numbers 21:8
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Make a fiery [serpent], and set it on a pole; and it shall be that everyone who is bitten, when he looks at it, shall live."

entries.title: Numbers 21:9
segments: So Moses made a bronze serpent, and put it on a pole; and so it was, if a serpent had bitten anyone, when he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.

entries.title: Numbers 21:10
segments: ¶Now the children of Israel moved on and camped in Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 21:11
segments: And they journeyed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, in the wilderness which [is] east of Moab, toward the sunrise.

entries.title: Numbers 21:12
segments: From there they moved and camped in the Valley of Zered.

entries.title: Numbers 21:13
segments: From there they moved and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which [is] in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon [is] the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:14
segments: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: "Waheb in Suphah, The brooks of the Arnon,

entries.title: Numbers 21:15
segments: And the slope of the brooks That reaches to the dwelling of Ar, And lies on the border of Moab."

entries.title: Numbers 21:16
segments: From there [they went] to Beer, which [is] the well where the LORD said to Moses, "Gather the people together, and I will give them water."

entries.title: Numbers 21:17
segments: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! All of you sing to it-

entries.title: Numbers 21:18
segments: The well the leaders sank, Dug by the nation's nobles, By the lawgiver, with their staves." And from the wilderness [they went] to Mattanah,

entries.title: Numbers 21:19
segments: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

entries.title: Numbers 21:20
segments: and from Bamoth, [in] the valley that [is] in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah which looks down on the wasteland.

entries.title: Numbers 21:21
segments: ¶Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 21:22
segments: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into fields or vineyards; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the King's Highway until we have passed through your territory."

entries.title: Numbers 21:23
segments: But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. So Sihon gathered all his people together and went out against Israel in the wilderness, and he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 21:24
segments: Then Israel defeated him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the people of Ammon; for the border of the people of Ammon [was] fortified.

entries.title: Numbers 21:25
segments: So Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all its villages.

entries.title: Numbers 21:26
segments: For Heshbon [was] the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and had taken all his land from his hand as far as the Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:27
segments: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say: "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; Let the city of Sihon be repaired.

entries.title: Numbers 21:28
segments: "For fire went out from Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon; It consumed Ar of Moab, The lords of the heights of the Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:29
segments: Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, O people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To Sihon king of the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:30
segments: "But we have shot at them; Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon. Then we laid waste as far as Nophah, Which [reaches] to Medeba."

entries.title: Numbers 21:31
segments: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:32
segments: Then Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took its villages and drove out the Amorites who [were] there.

entries.title: Numbers 21:33
segments: And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. So Og king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

entries.title: Numbers 21:34
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon."

entries.title: Numbers 21:35
segments: So they defeated him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left him; and they took possession of his land.
